dogecoin.text: Is there any reason to prefer #BCH over #Zcash or #dogecoin? #ZEC and #DOGE transactions are cheaper than #BCH; ZEC is more private; and BCH suffers from mining centralization.

@Hodl_Lambo @rogerkver @BITCOlNCASH @BitcoinCashFans @mises @feeonline @lopp @VinnyLingham @tylerwinklevoss @winklevoss @brian_armstrong @GovJVentura 3/ This would explain why Roger prefers BCH over other faster coins like Dogecoin: BCH is the only one with centralized mining control, plus a mechanism to maintain said centralized control (assuming no PoW change).

@crypto_daze @CryptoRick6 @justicemate Dogecoin (as well as other alts) have lower fees than BCH. Why does Roger not promote Doge instead of BCH? I speculate the answer to be that Roger considers *centralized control* of BCH mining to be a *feature*, not a bug: it means he can continue to increase blocksize as needed.
